children: Alamo is ceasing production of its Dixie Chopper branded line of products.
The maker of mowers and street sweepers said it was exiting the brand, which primarily makes riding mowers, as part of an ongoing product portfolio review.

Alamo expects to incur $15 million to $20 million in charges during the third quarter, including $1 million to $4 million in spending related to inventory returns, contractual purchase commitments and other costs.
Earlier this month, the company said it would cease production of Boxer branded products.
